declarations.name: isoWeek
declarations.description: ISO 8601 week number: weeks start on Monday and week 1 holds the year's first Thursday.

A week at a glance: seven day columns on an hour scale, each event a block from its start to its end time.

Without `date` it is a typical week, with no dates — a slot says which weekday it happens on (`day: "mon"`) and
repeats every week, or only in odd or even ISO weeks (`weeks: "odd"`), as school and shared-custody schedules do.
Odd and even weeks are off by default: set `alternate-weeks` to honour `weeks` and show an Odd week | Even week
switch (a segmented `c2-button-group`, themed through its own `--c2-button-group__*` variables) above the grid,
opening on the kind of the current week. Without it every event shows each week. The current week's number sits in
a badge on its button.

Set `date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, any day of the week) to show a real calendar week instead: the day headers carry the
day of the month, the header shows the week's range with previous week / next week arrows and a Today button that
update `date` and fire `week-change`, and an event may carry a `date` of its own to show in that week only, while
`day` events keep repeating every week. With `alternate-weeks`, `weeks` then follows the ISO number of the week
shown; there is no switch.

`editable` turns it into a planner the user arranges; the component never changes `events` itself, it reports what
the user asked for and the app updates `events`:
- Clicking an empty spot fires `slot-click` with the time under the pointer, snapped down to `snap-minutes`, and an
  hour-long range. From the keyboard, each day column starts with a "New event" button (shown on focus, at the
  column's first free hour) that fires the same event.
- Dragging a block moves it to another time or day, and dragging its bottom edge resizes it; a preview follows the
  pointer, Escape cancels, and the drop fires `event-change` with the new placement. A press that does not move
  is still a click (`event-click`). From the keyboard, on a focused block: Alt+Arrow Up/Down moves it by
  `snap-minutes`, Alt+Arrow Left/Right by a day, and Alt+Shift+Arrow Up/Down changes its end time.

`heading` puts a title at the start of the header; the `heading` slot replaces it with markup of your own (an icon,
a link, an editable field). The `actions` slot puts buttons of your own at the end of the header, e.g. "Add event"
or a settings menu.

Text follows `locale`, or the browser's language when it is not set: day names, dates and "today"/"this week" come
from `Intl`, and the other labels from a built-in list (English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese,
Dutch, Vietnamese; other languages fall back to English). Today's column is tinted, inside the grid lines, and
carries a line at the current time. Overlapping events cascade, each stepped in from the one it overlaps; the hour
range grows to fit every event.

Below 640px of width the planner shows three days, and below 420px one, of a strip that scrolls sideways and snaps
to a day: swiped on a touch screen, paged with the previous/next arrows that then appear in its header. It opens on
today, and the hour labels stay in place.

cssProperties.description: Line under each hour. Translucent, so it stays visible over today's tint.
cssProperties.name: --c2-week-planner__hour--border

cssProperties.description: Space between the controls in the `actions` slot.
cssProperties.name: --c2-week-planner__actions--gap

cssProperties.description: Previous/next day arrows, shown when the planner is too narrow for seven days.
cssProperties.name: --c2-week-planner__navigation--size

cssProperties.description: Block colour of an event without its own `color`.
cssProperties.name: --c2-week-planner__event--background

cssProperties.description: The dated week's range in the header.
cssProperties.name: --c2-week-planner__week-title--color

cssProperties.description: Day of the month in a dated week's day headers.
cssProperties.name: --c2-week-planner__day-number--font-weight

cssProperties.description: With `editable`, the hour under the pointer in an empty spot.
cssProperties.name: --c2-week-planner__slot__hover--background

cssProperties.description: Where a dragged event would land, and the focused "New event" button.

cssParts.description: Heading region wrapping the `heading` slot and the `heading` text fallback; assigned content keeps its own styles.
cssParts.name: heading

cssParts.description: Actions region wrapping the `actions` slot at the end of the header, before the previous/next arrows; assigned controls keep their own styles.
cssParts.name: actions

slots.description: Title at the start of the header, in place of the `heading` text. It names the planner unless `heading` or `aria-label` is set.
slots.name: heading

slots.description: Controls at the end of the header, before the previous/next arrows, e.g. an "Add event" button.
slots.name: actions

members.name: atStart
members.description: The day strip is scrolled to its first / last day; disables the matching arrow on a narrow planner.

members.name: preview
members.description: Where a dragged event would land.

members.name: hover
members.description: With `editable`, the snapped hour under the pointer in an empty spot.

members.name: firstShownDay
members.description: Index of the leftmost day the strip shows, restored when a resize would leave it between two days.

members.name: renderedWeek
members.description: First day of the dated week last rendered, to bring the strip back to its start when the week changes.

members.name: layout

type.text: { columns: DayColumn[]; firstHour: number; lastHour: number }

members.description: The columns and hour range of the last render, which the pointer and keyboard handlers work in.

members.name: suppressClick
members.description: Swallows the click that ends a drag, so dropping an event does not also open it or add one.

members.name: refocus
members.description: The event block to focus again once the app has applied a keyboard move: its key and new place.

members.name: events
members.description: The plan: `{ id?, title, day?, date?, start, end, weeks?, color? }` entries. Accepts a JSON string as an attribute.

members.name: date
members.description:
Shows the calendar week holding this date, `YYYY-MM-DD` (any day of the week). Empty — the default — shows a
typical week without dates. The header navigation updates it.

members.name: editable
members.description: Lets the user add events by clicking an empty spot and move or resize them by dragging; see `slot-click` and `event-change`.

members.name: snapMinutes
members.description: Step, in minutes, that `slot-click` times, drags and keyboard moves snap to.

members.name: alternateWeeks
members.description: Honours each event's `weeks` and shows the Odd week | Even week switch. Off by default: every event shows each week.

members.name: parity
members.description: Kind of week shown with `alternate-weeks`. Defaults to the kind of the current ISO week.

members.name: startHour
members.description: First hour on the scale; earlier events extend it.

members.name: endHour
members.description: Last hour on the scale; later events extend it.

members.name: weekStart
members.description: First day of the week. Defaults to the convention of `locale` (Sunday in `en-US`, Monday in `fr` or `en-GB`).

members.name: locale
members.description: Language of the planner's text and day names, e.g. `fr` or `en-GB`. Defaults to the browser's language.

members.name: heading
members.description: Title shown at the start of the header, e.g. "Kids' schedule". It also names the planner for assistive technology.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name for the planner. Defaults to `heading`, else "Week plan" in the planner's language.

members.name: scrollDays
members.description: Moves the strip by the number of days it shows, so the arrows page through the week.

members.name: firstWeekday
members.description: First day of the week as `Date#getDay` numbers it: `week-start` when set, else the locale's convention.

members.name: weekStartDate
members.description: First day of the dated week shown, or null for a typical week.

members.name: relative
members.description: "today", "this week", … in the planner's language.

members.name: todayLabel
members.description: The Today button's label: "today" in the planner's language, capitalised.

members.name: showWeek
members.description: Shows the week holding `date`; fires `week-change` when that is another week.

members.name: minutesAt
members.description: Minutes since midnight at a pointer's height in a day column, snapped down to `snap-minutes`.

members.name: changesFor
members.description: The placement `changes` for an event moved to a weekday (and, in a dated week, a date) from `from` to `to`.

members.name: handleGestureKey
members.description: Escape drops a drag in progress; the block stays where it was.

members.name: handleEventKey
members.description: Alt+Arrow moves the focused block by `snap-minutes` or a day; Alt+Shift+Arrow Up/Down changes its end.

members.name: weekTitle
members.description: "Sep 28 – Oct 4, 2026" in the planner's language.

members.name: renderAdd
members.description: The keyboard way to add: a button at the column's first free hour, shown while it has focus.

events.name: parity-change
events.description: Fired when the switch shows the other kind of week; `detail.parity` is `odd` or `even`.

events.name: week-change
events.description: Fired when the header navigation of a dated planner shows another week; `detail.start` and `detail.end` are its first and last day as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Does not bubble.

events.name: event-click
events.description: Fired when an event block is activated; `detail.event` is the entry from `events`.

events.name: slot-click
events.description: With `editable`, fired when an empty spot or a day's "New event" button is activated: `{ day, date?, start, end }`, `start` snapped to `snap-minutes` and `end` an hour later. Add the event to `events` yourself.

events.name: event-change
events.description: With `editable`, fired when an event is dropped after a drag or moved/resized from the keyboard: `{ event, changes }`, `event` the original entry and `changes` its new `start`, `end` and `day` or `date`. Update `events` yourself.
